verdict.rationale: Trivy's secret scanner explicitly supports container images, filesystem, and git repositories (trivy-docs-3, trivy-docs-10), covering the 'Docker images' part of the story, but there is no evidence of secret scanning for S3 buckets or CI logs specifically. A 'trivy aws' subcommand exists (trivy-comm-15) but it's shown crashing and is not documented as a secret-detection target. missing for 10: documented S3 bucket secret scanning, documented CI log secret scanning, and hands-on confirmation these non-git sources work reliably.
